summary: A video and photo sharing platform similar to YouTube, where users can upload and share both photos and videos in separate sections with user authentication
architectural_notes: Platform requires separate content management for photos and videos
User authentication required for upload functionality
YouTube-like interface with distinct photo and video sections
Video engagement features required: download, like, and comment functionality
Channel customization needed for user-defined names
Video quality selection system required for adaptive streaming
known_issues: After upload, galleries appear empty - uploaded content not displaying

existing_features.title: Implement user authentication system using Internet Identity that allows users to sign in and maintain their identity across sessions
Build video upload interface that allows authenticated users to upload video files with title and description fields
Build photo upload interface that allows authenticated users to upload photo files with title and description fields
Create separate video gallery section that displays all uploaded videos in a grid layout with thumbnails, titles, and uploader information, similar to YouTube's video browsing interface
Create separate photo gallery section that displays all uploaded photos in a grid layout with thumbnails, titles, and uploader information
Implement video player view that displays selected videos with full metadata, allowing users to watch uploaded videos
Implement photo viewer that displays selected photos with full metadata in a lightbox or detail view

Design a creative visual theme with modern, media-focused aesthetics featuring bold colors, clean typography, and card-based layouts that emphasize visual content. Apply this design consistently across all pages including galleries, upload forms, and media viewers
Update useVideos hook to call the backend listVideos method instead of returning an empty array
Update usePhotos hook to call the backend listPhotos method instead of returning an empty array
Add download button to video player page that allows users to download the video file they are currently viewing
Implement like functionality for videos that allows users to like videos and displays the total like count
Add comment system for videos that allows users to post comments and view all comments on a video
Allow users to set and edit a custom channel name instead of displaying their principal, with support for shorter custom names
Add video quality selector to video player that allows users to choose playback quality for online viewing

new_feature_requests.summary: Separate galleries/sections for photos and videos
Create backend data model and storage for video uploads with metadata including title, description, uploader identity, upload timestamp, and video file reference
Create backend data model and storage for photo uploads with metadata including title, description, uploader identity, upload timestamp, and photo file reference
Implement backend listVideos method that returns all uploaded videos with their metadata (id, title, description, uploader, timestamp)
Implement backend listPhotos method that returns all uploaded photos with their metadata (id, title, description, uploader, timestamp)
Replace the empty state SVG icon at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/div[2]/div[1]/svg[1] with appropriate content or loading state when galleries have items
Add video download option for uploaded videos
Allow users to set and edit channel name with shorter custom names
Add video quality selection option for online viewing
